subject: Serve affinity waiver for Medexa pilot — regional-only model selection
messages:
From: Dr. Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@medexa.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot request: strict serving affinity & region lock

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Medexa is preparing a narrow clinical pilot that must run in the US region only and cannot fall back to any alternate model variants due to regulatory data residency and traceability requirements.

Specific asks:
- Region: US-only (no cross-region routing).
- No automatic fallback: if the pinned model variant is unavailable, traffic should fail closed rather than fall back.
- Forced model selection: pin to the quantized v1.2 variant we discussed (smaller memory/KV behavior).

Pilot start: target Aug 15. Expected traffic: 10rps peak, burst to 25rps. We attached Medexa's regulatory note and the pilot scope for context.

Can Redwood confirm feasibility and any gating items (SLA, capacity reservation, additional security controls)? We need a written exception and timeline for internal approval.

[Attachment: medexa_regulatory_request.pdf]
[Attachment: pilot_scope.xlsx]

Best,
Elena Suarez
Director, Clinical Integration
Medexa Health

Marissa — I'll need an initial commercial guidance (reserved capacity vs burst credits) so Medexa can decide.

Thanks — I’ll consolidate responses and then coordinate with Elena for a written exception.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: strict serving affinity & region lock

Vanessa —

High-level technical assessment below after a quick sync with runtime and routing:

Feasibility:
- The runtime can support a pinned model variant with fallback disabled, but there are caveats. Fallback is a safety net baked into the smart-router; disabling it means any outage or eviction of the serving host will cause request failures.
- US-only placement is supported via strict routing rules and AZ affinity; we can map the Medexa workload to us-west1/us-east1 only.

Tradeoffs & Risks:
- Availability: without fallback, the SLO drops unless we reserve capacity. Recommend reserved capacity (Dedicated pool) sized to handle peak + 25% buffer.
- Cold starts / KV warmup: quantized variant has smaller memory but will still need KV-cache warmup; initial requests could be slower. We can preload cache during a canary window.
- Monitoring: we must add tight observability (token-level latency, eviction counts, cache-miss rate) and an automated alert to abort the pilot if error rates spike.

Recommended approach:
1) Create a pinned routing policy for customer MEDX-2026-PILOT-09 that maps to model variant v1.2-quantized-us and marks region=us with fallback=false.
2) Reserve a small Dedicated pool for the pilot (estimate below) and enable reserved pre-warming for KV cache.
3) Run a 48-hour canary (traffic ramp from 0.5rps to 10rps) and validate latency and error budgets.
4) Require Legal/Security sign-off on retention and KMS config before we flip to full pilot.

Capacity estimate (quick): 10 rps sustained -> 2 GPUs (NVIDIA A100 class) with autoscaling headroom for bursts; reserve 3 GPUs to be safe during peak. Ops should refine.

I attached a short technical impact note for the runbook. If product approves, we can draft the exception language.

[Attachment: technical_impact_notes.pdf]

—Marcus
Product Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Team —

Thanks Marcus, that readout is exactly what I needed. Quick coord and owners:

- Karthik: Legal & Security to review Medexa attachments and confirm whether KMS + 90-day audit retention satisfies their regulatory doc; please flag any contract language changes. Target: initial redline by Aug 6.
- Marcus / Eng: prepare canary config and a pre-warm plan for KV cache; include expected warmup time and rollback criteria. Target: config ready by Aug 6 so we can start canary on Aug 7.

I will consolidate and send a short exception letter to Elena once we have the commercial and legal sign-offs. Also looping in Support channel and adding INF-3421 to track the work.
